name: advanced_pawn_chain_advantage
description: The side to move has more pawns on the fifth rank or beyond than the opponent, indicating superior space and advanced structure.
source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'advanced_pawn_chain_advantage'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has more pawns on the fifth rank or beyond than the opponent, indicating superior space and advanced structure.'
def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    import chess
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    opp = not stm
    
    # Count advanced pawns for each side (rank 5+ for White, rank 4- for Black)
    # For side to move: if White, advanced means rank >= 5 (index 4+); if Black, rank <= 4 (index 3-)
    stm_advanced = 0
    opp_advanced = 0
    
    for sq in chess.SQUARES:
        piece = board.piece_at(sq)
        if piece is None or piece.piece_type != chess.PAWN:
            continue
        rank = chess.square_rank(sq)
        if piece.color == chess.WHITE:
            if rank >= 4:  # rank 5 (index 4) or higher
                if piece.color == stm:
                    stm_advanced += 1
                else:
                    opp_advanced += 1
        else:  # BLACK
            if rank <= 3:  # rank 4 (index 3) or lower
                if piece.color == stm:
                    stm_advanced += 1
                else:
                    opp_advanced += 1
    
    return stm_advanced > opp_advanced
